findings.now: So for now we have to give up on the hour-long breakthrough that therapy aims for, since an hour spent working on the trauma itself overwhelms an armored nervous system more than it heals it.
findings.published: A sensitized, armored nervous system cannot metabolize sixty minutes of trauma processing; that is a flood, not a fix.
findings.why: "overwhelms ... more than it heals it" suggests the hour still heals somewhat, where PUBLISHED said flatly that the system cannot take it and that it is a flood, not a fix (and "sensitized" is dropped).
